name: Event Production
description: Plan and execute a live or hybrid event with scope, budget, run-of-show, vendors, safety, accessibility, contingency, and post-event review.

tasks.name: Define event brief
tasks.objective: Set purpose, audience, format, capacity, venue/streaming needs, dates, budget, success measures, accessibility, safety, legal/permit constraints, and non-negotiables.

tasks.name: Build production plan
tasks.objective: Create workstreams for venue, program, talent/speakers, registration, staffing, vendors, AV, catering, signage, transport, security, accessibility, and communications with owners and deadlines.

tasks.name: Contract and coordinate vendors
tasks.objective: Normalize scopes, deliverables, load-in/out, power/network, insurance, cancellation, payment, accessibility responsibilities, technical specs, contacts, and escalation paths.

tasks.name: Create run-of-show
tasks.objective: Build minute-level operational timing including cues, transitions, speaker/talent movement, AV states, staffing, meals/breaks, doors, shutdown, and communications channels.

tasks.name: Run contingency review
tasks.objective: Test weather, illness/no-show, AV/network failure, accessibility failures, crowd/safety issues, late vendors, transport, power, and schedule compression; assign triggers and backups.

tasks.name: Execute and close
tasks.objective: Run production, capture incidents and changes, reconcile vendors/budget, collect attendee/staff feedback, archive assets, and publish lessons and follow-up actions.
